home.title: clewwiki
home.tagline: A self-hosted knowledge base that humans and coding agents can write in together.
home.signedOutHint: Sign in to manage this workspace.
home.apiMe: Identity of the caller. Accepts a browser session or an agent bearer token.
home.apiPages: Read and write wiki pages. Requires the pages:read or pages:write scope.
home.apiClaims: Take, renew and release a claim on a page before writing to it. Requires the pages:write scope.
home.apiPresence: Every claim held in this workspace right now, with its notes. Requires the pages:read scope.

pages.title: Pages
pages.intro: Every page is written either for people or for agents, and a pair of the two can be linked so a change to one is visible from the other.
pages.emptyIntro: This workspace has no pages yet. Create the first one, or have an agent create it over the REST API.
pages.deleteConfirm: Delete this page and everything below it? Its history is kept, but it stops being readable.
pages.emptyBody: This page has no content yet.

presence.title: Presence
presence.intro: Every claim held in this workspace right now — by people and by agent tokens alike. A claim is a lease on a page or one of its sections: while it is held, nobody else can write there, and it ends on its own if its holder stops renewing it.
presence.empty: Nobody is holding a page right now.
presence.activeHeading: {count, plural, one {# active claim} other {# active claims}}
presence.expiresIn: {seconds, plural, one {# second left} other {# seconds left}}
presence.forceReleaseConfirm: Release the claim held by {name}? Their unsaved work will be refused when they try to save.

editor.title: Title
editor.pathHint: Leave empty to derive it from the title and the parent. Lowercase words separated by hyphens, for example /backend/auth.
editor.parentHint: Where this page sits in the tree. Moving a page moves everything below it.
editor.kindHint: Technical pages are written for agents; human pages are written for people.
editor.summaryHint: One line, shown in search results and in the page header.
editor.bodyHint: Markdown. A fenced block marked mermaid is rendered as a diagram.
editor.errorForbidden: You are not signed in, or your account is not a member of this workspace.
editor.errorValidation: Check the fields and try again.
editor.errorConflict: A page already exists at that path.
editor.errorStaleBase: Someone else changed this page while you were editing it. Open it again and reapply your changes.
editor.errorGeneric: The page could not be saved. Check the server logs for details.
editor.claimAcquiring: Taking a claim on this page…
editor.claimHeld: You hold this page. It is released when you save or leave this form.
editor.claimBlockedHint: Editing is blocked while someone else holds the page. Their claim ends on its own if they stop working on it.
editor.claimLost: Your claim on this page has ended. Reopen the editor to take it again; saving now will be refused.
editor.claimError: The claim could not be taken. Reload the page and try again.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Full-text search across every page in this workspace, technical and human alike.
search.label: Search pages

setup.title: Create the administrator account
setup.intro: This instance has no accounts yet. The account you create here becomes the administrator of the workspace. There are no default credentials, and this page stops existing once an account exists.
setup.workspaceNameHint: Shown in the interface. You can use your team or project name.
setup.name: Your name
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Nothing is emailed; store it in a password manager.
setup.setupTokenHint: Proves you operate this server. It is the value of CLEWWIKI_SETUP_TOKEN, or the one-time token printed in the server log at start-up: docker compose logs web | grep "setup token"
setup.errorSetupToken: The setup token is not correct.
setup.errorGeneric: Setup could not be completed. Check the server logs for details.
setup.errorAlreadyDone: Setup has already been completed on this instance.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with the account created during setup.
login.error: Email or password is incorrect, or there have been too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens let an agent authenticate against the REST API without a browser session. A token is bound to this workspace, carries a fixed set of scopes, and can be revoked at any time.
tokens.adminOnly: Only administrators can issue or revoke agent tokens.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameHint: How you will recognise this token later, for example the machine or agent using it.
tokens.expiryHint: Prefer a fixed lifetime and rotation. A token with no expiry stays valid until it is revoked.
tokens.scopesHint: Grant the narrowest set the agent actually needs. pages:delete lets a token remove whole subtrees; pages:write alone does not.
tokens.secretWarning: This is the only time the token is shown. It is stored as a hash and cannot be recovered.
tokens.listEmpty: No tokens have been issued yet.
tokens.errorGeneric: The token could not be issued.

about.title: About clewwiki
about.what: clewwiki is a self-hosted knowledge base for humans and coding agents to write in together. Conflict-safe claims replace silent overwrites, documentation pages carry a staleness flag anchored to the code they describe, and each page comes in two linked forms — one written for people, one written for agents.
about.license: clewwiki is licensed under AGPL-3.0, with additional terms permitted under AGPL-3.0 Section 7 covering author attribution and the marking of modified versions.

errors.notFoundBody: The page you requested does not exist.
errors.genericBody: The request could not be completed. Try again, and check the server logs if it keeps failing.

anchors.heading: Anchored code
anchors.empty: This page is not anchored to any code yet.
anchors.noRepository: No source repository is linked to this workspace yet, so anchors cannot be created or checked. An administrator can link one under Repository.
anchors.fileHint: Path inside the repository, for example Sources/Audio/Mixer.swift.
anchors.targetHint: A declaration such as Mixer.blend(first:second:), or a line range such as 42-58 for a block with no declaration to point at.
anchors.sectionHint: Leave empty to anchor the whole page. A named section flags only that part of it.
anchors.fallbackShareLabel: {percent}% of this workspace’s anchors use the line-range fallback. Line ranges do not survive an edit above them, so a rising share means the badges are getting noisier.
anchors.treeBadge: {count, plural, one {# anchor is out of date} other {# anchors are out of date}}
anchors.detailBodyChanged: The declaration is still there, but its body changed. Read the diff and update the page, then confirm.
anchors.detailMoved: The declaration moved to {file}. Nothing about it changed.
anchors.detailFileMissing: {file} is no longer in the repository at this ref.
anchors.detailDeclarationMissing: The file is still there, but the declaration is gone. This needs a decision, not an edit.
anchors.detailRangeMissing: The file no longer reaches the anchored lines.
anchors.errorGeneric: The anchor could not be updated. Check the server logs for details.

repository.title: Repository
repository.intro: Anchors tie a page to a declaration in your source code. This is the repository they are checked against.
repository.adminOnly: Only administrators can change the linked repository.
repository.formIntro: The server keeps a read-only mirror and never checks anything out, builds anything, or runs anything from it.
repository.urlHint: An https:// URL, without credentials in it. file:// paths work only when the operator set ALLOW_FILE_REPOSITORIES=true.
repository.refHint: The branch, tag or commit anchors are checked against unless a caller names another.
repository.tokenEnvHint: The name of an environment variable holding the access token — never the token itself. It must be CLEWWIKI_GIT_TOKEN or CLEWWIKI_GIT_TOKEN_<NAME>, and it is only ever sent to https:// URLs. Leave empty for a public or local repository.
repository.saved: Saved. Anchors in this workspace are now checked against this repository.
repository.errorValidation: Check the fields and try again.
